Im shocked to see this set has such low ratings. I had never used Tula before, but for the last 2 years ive been struggling with hormonal acne (at 38 years old) and have been trying countless products. Using this set my skin has looked the best it has in 2 years. I still get the occasional stubborn closed comedone, but i also get a professional facial twice a month so my esthetician handles the extractions I can't deal with myself. I highly recommend this set, and its a great price! The moisturizer actually keeps my dry skin feeling healthy -not tight or oily- and the serum has faded so much of my post acne hyperpigmentation!

A few years back Tula products were phenomenal. The company has changed the formulations, shrunk the packaging, and raised the prices! Unfortunately I won't but Tula anymore but found several alternatives that works.
